notes: Freshpet, Inc. (NASDAQ: FRPT) — manufacturer of refrigerated, fresh pet foods (primarily for dogs, with a smaller cat line). Branded as Freshpet — sold via dedicated branded refrigerator units ("Freshpet Fridges") in ~28,000 retail stores across N. America and the UK (Petco, PetSmart, Walmart, Target, Costco, Kroger, Tesco). Single product / brand company. Fiscal year = calendar. Heavy multi-year capex cycle (Ennis TX, Bethlehem PA plants) for capacity to support ~30% volume CAGR. Reached EBITDA breakeven FY22 and expanding EBITDA margin since. CIK 1304161. 10-Ks at sec.gov.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue $318.8M (+33%). Adj EBITDA $51.5M. Strong COVID-era pet adoption tailwind. Equity raise funded Ennis TX kitchens construction.
FY21: revenue $425.5M (+33%). Adj EBITDA $50.0M. Margin pressure from chicken / labour cost inflation + start-up costs at Ennis. Convertible notes issued ($402M).
FY22: revenue $595.2M (+40%). Adj EBITDA $11.6M (GAAP EBITDA negative — ramp losses + impairment). Trough margin year. Heavy investment in Ennis kitchens 2 + 3.
FY23: revenue $766.9M (+29%). Adj EBITDA $99.1M. Margin recovery as Ennis ramped + chicken cost normalized. Reached operational scale.

FY24: revenue $975.2M (+27%). Adj EBITDA $164.4M (~17% margin — significant operating leverage). Net income positive ~$58M; EPS ~$1.20. First fully profitable year. Capex remains heavy as Ennis expansion + Bethlehem build-out continue.
